652	def evaluate(
653	    jobs: str,
654	    supply: str,
655	    signals: str,
656	    trades: str,
657	    dispatch: str,
658	    execution: str,
659	    ledger: str,
660	    job_id: str,
661	    key: str,
662	    at: int,
663	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
664	    """Re-evaluate one unfinished trade and advise keep or migrate.
665	
666	    The seven paths, ``job_id`` and ``key`` must be non-empty strings
667	    and ``at`` a non-boolean non-negative integer evaluation moment; the
668	    seven paths must also resolve to distinct real locations. Any
669	    violation raises ``ValueError`` before a business file is read.
670	
671	    The acceptance, supply, signal, clearing, dispatch and execution
672	    files are read as one snapshot under their shared locks together
673	    with the advice ledger's exclusive lock, all seven taken in
674	    resolved real-path order. The retained candidate is the exact
675	    resource version the job's trade froze; every migration candidate is
676	    another resource's highest supply version valid at ``at``. Each
677	    candidate must sit in one of the job's regions, cover its residency,
678	    stay available until the deadline and price within both budgets on
679	    the region's latest signal valid at ``at`` -- a region without such
680	    a signal contributes nothing. Capacity is deducted per exact
681	    resource version for every trade other jobs booked; this job's own
682	    trade is never deducted against itself. Candidates are ordered by
683	    signal carbon intensity, signal unit cost and resource id.
684	
685	    Advice is refused, in this order, when the dispatch decision has
686	    already succeeded or any execution plan has completed
687	    (``ValueError``), when an execution plan is still active
688	    (``PermissionError``) and when ``at`` is past the job deadline
689	    (``TimeoutError``); none of these writes. With no feasible candidate
690	    the call raises ``LookupError`` without writing.
691	
692	    Returns ``(record, created)``. The record freezes, in order, the job
693	    id, the evaluation moment, the current selection, the dispatch and
694	    execution states, the ordered candidates, the recommendation
695	    (``keep`` when the first candidate is the current version, otherwise
696	    ``migrate``) and the target selection. A missing advice ledger is
697	    created only by the first record, the record and its audit event
698	    committed together in one synced atomic write. Replaying the same
699	    key with the same job and moment returns the stored record with
700	    ``False`` without writing; the same key with a changed request
701	    raises ``ValueError`` and leaves the ledger untouched.
702	
703	    An unknown job or dispatch decision raises ``KeyError``; a job
704	    without a trade and an empty feasible set raise ``LookupError``;
705	    neither creates the ledger. Missing input files or the ledger parent
706	    raise ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid arguments, structure, ordering,
707	    references or non-canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other
708	    locking, read/write or sync failures raise ``OSError``.
709	    """
710	    for value in (jobs, supply, signals, trades, dispatch, execution,
711	                  ledger, job_id, key):
712	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
713	            raise ValueError("the seven paths, job_id and key must be "
714	                             "non-empty strings")
715	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
716	        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")
717	
718	    job_real = os.path.realpath(jobs)
719	    supply_real = os.path.realpath(supply)
720	    signal_real = os.path.realpath(signals)
721	    trades_real = os.path.realpath(trades)
722	    dispatch_real = os.path.realpath(dispatch)
723	    execution_real = os.path.realpath(execution)
724	    ledger_real = os.path.realpath(ledger)
725	    all_paths = (job_real, supply_real, signal_real, trades_real,
726	                 dispatch_real, execution_real, ledger_real)
727	    if len(set(all_paths)) != 7:
728	        raise ValueError("the seven paths must be distinct real paths")
729	
730	    store = _get_store(ledger)
731	    with store.lock:
732	        # Locks are taken in one resolved-real-path order shared by every
733	        # caller, so concurrent evaluations can never deadlock; the
734	        # advice ledger lock is exclusive, the six snapshot locks shared.
735	        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
736	            for locked in sorted(set(all_paths)):
737	                stack.enter_context(
738	                    _lock(locked, shared=(locked != ledger_real)))
739	
740	            accepted, job_map, job_events, job_raw = \
741	                _jobs._load_submit_file(job_real)
742	            if job_raw is None:
743	                raise FileNotFoundError(
744	                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} does not exist")
745	            if job_raw != _jobs._serialize_submit_file(
746	                    accepted, job_map, job_events):
747	                raise ValueError(
748	                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} is not in canonical "
749	                    "compact form")
750	            history, _supply_map, _supply_events, supply_raw = \
751	                _resources._load_file(supply_real)
752	            if supply_raw is None:
753	                raise FileNotFoundError(
754	                    f"supply file {supply_real!r} does not exist")
755	            signal_history, _signal_map, _signal_events, signal_raw = \
756	                _signals._load_file(signal_real)
757	            if signal_raw is None:
758	                raise FileNotFoundError(
759	                    f"signal file {signal_real!r} does not exist")
760	            # Live trades freeze signal versions, so the signal history
761	            # resolves their references; static trades validate as before.
762	            cleared, _clear_keys, trades_raw = _market._load_clear_ledger(
763	                trades_real, accepted, history, signal_history)
764	            if trades_raw is None:
765	                raise FileNotFoundError(
766	                    f"clearing ledger {trades_real!r} does not exist")
767	            decisions, _dispatch_keys, _dispatch_events, dispatch_raw = \
768	                _dispatch._load_ledger(dispatch_real)
769	            if dispatch_raw is None:
770	                raise FileNotFoundError(
771	                    f"dispatch ledger {dispatch_real!r} does not exist")
772	            # The execution ledger is a required input, as in the other
773	            # layers that read it: advice presupposes a claim, and the
774	            # natural re-evaluation point is a job whose prior execution
775	            # attempt failed or was interrupted (its plan history frozen
776	            # in this ledger). A missing file is FileNotFoundError.
777	            plans, _plan_keys, _plan_events = \
778	                _execution._load_existing_ledger(execution_real)[:3]
779	            records, events, old_bytes = _load_ledger(
780	                ledger_real, accepted, cleared, history, signal_history)
781	
782	            request = {"job_id": job_id, "at": at}
783	            binding = records.get(key)
784	            if binding is not None:
785	                if binding["job_id"] != job_id or binding["at"] != at:
786	                    raise ValueError("idempotency key was already used with "
787	                                     "a different request")
788	                # An equivalent replay returns the stored record without
789	                # re-evaluating or rewriting a byte.
790	                return copy.deepcopy(binding), False
791	
792	            job = accepted.get(job_id)
793	            if job is None:
794	                raise KeyError(job_id)
795	            trade = cleared.get(job_id)
796	            if trade is None:
797	                raise LookupError("job has no recorded trade")
798	            decision = decisions.get(job_id)
799	            if decision is None:
800	                raise KeyError(job_id)
801	
802	            job_plans = plans.get(job_id, {})
803	            # Refusal order is fixed: a finished booking is a ValueError,
804	            # work still in flight is a PermissionError, and a moment
805	            # past the deadline is a TimeoutError.
806	            if decision["state"] == "succeeded" \
807	                    or any(plan["state"] == "completed"
808	                           for plan in job_plans.values()):
809	                raise ValueError("a finished booking cannot be "
810	                                 "re-evaluated")
811	            if any(plan["state"] == "active"
812	                   for plan in job_plans.values()):
813	                raise PermissionError("an execution plan is active")
814	            if at > job["deadline"]:
815	                raise TimeoutError("evaluation moment exceeds the job "
816	                                   "deadline")
817	
818	            current_id = trade["resource_id"]
819	            current_version = trade["version"]
820	            current = {"resource_id": current_id,
821	                       "version": current_version}
822	            work = job["work"]
823	            regions = set(job["regions"])
824	            residency = set(job["residency"])
825	
826	            # Capacity already booked per exact resource version by
827	            # every OTHER job; this job's own frozen occupancy is never
828	            # deducted against itself.
829	            booked: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
830	            for other_id, other in cleared.items():
831	                if other_id == job_id:
832	                    continue
833	                slot = (other["resource_id"], other["version"])
834	                booked[slot] = booked.get(slot, 0) + other["work"]
835	
836	            candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
837	
838	            def consider(resource_record: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
839	                if resource_record["region"] not in regions:
840	                    return
841	                if not residency <= set(resource_record["residency"]):
842	                    return
843	                if resource_record["end"] < job["deadline"]:
844	                    return
845	                signal = _latest_signal(
846	                    signal_history, resource_record["region"], at)
847	                if signal is None:
848	                    return
849	                remaining = resource_record["capacity"] - booked.get(
