2576	            or set(data.keys()) != set(_SETTLE_ROOT_FIELDS):
2577	        raise ValueError("settlement ledger root must be an object with "
2578	                         "keys version, records, idempotency and audit")
2579	    if not _is_plain_int(data["version"]) \
2580	            or data["version"] != _SETTLE_VERSION:
2581	        raise ValueError("unsupported settlement ledger version")
2582	    records_raw = data["records"]
2583	    idempotency_raw = data["idempotency"]
2584	    audit_raw = data["audit"]
2585	    if not isinstance(records_raw, dict) \
2586	            or not isinstance(idempotency_raw, dict) \
2587	            or not isinstance(audit_raw, dict):
2588	        raise ValueError("settlement sections must be objects")
2589	    _check_sorted_keys(records_raw, "records")
2590	    _check_sorted_keys(idempotency_raw, "idempotency")
2591	    _check_sorted_keys(audit_raw, "audit")
2592	
2593	    # The intent ledger is never archived, so each job's single recorded
2594	    # migration is settled at most once: two settlement records for one
2595	    # job would duplicate a close and break the generation sequence.
2596	    records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
2597	    settled_jobs: set[str] = set()
2598	    for key, record_raw in records_raw.items():
2599	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
2600	            raise ValueError("settlement keys must be non-empty strings")
2601	        record = _validate_settlement_record(
2602	            record_raw, accepted, trades, plans, intent_idempotency,
2603	            intent_events)
2604	        if record["job_id"] in settled_jobs:
2605	            raise ValueError("a terminal migration can only settle once")
2606	        settled_jobs.add(record["job_id"])
2607	        records[key] = record
2608	
2609	    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
2610	    for key, request_raw in idempotency_raw.items():
2611	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
2612	            raise ValueError("idempotency keys must be non-empty strings")

2614	        if key not in records:
2615	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must reference a "
2616	                             "recorded settlement")

2618	        if request["job_id"] != record["job_id"] \
2619	                or request["plan_key"] != record["plan_key"] \
2620	                or request["at"] != record["at"]:
2621	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry does not match its "
2622	                             "settlement")
2623	        idempotency[key] = request
2624	
2625	    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
2626	    for key, event_raw in audit_raw.items():
2627	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
2628	            raise ValueError("audit keys must be non-empty strings")
2629	        if not isinstance(event_raw, dict) \
2630	                or set(event_raw.keys()) != set(_EVENT_FIELDS):
2631	            raise ValueError("settlement audit event has invalid fields")
2632	        if event_raw["key"] != key:

2634	        request = _validate_settlement_request(event_raw["request"])
2635	        if request != idempotency.get(key):
2636	            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its "
2637	                             "idempotency entry")

2639	            event_raw["result"], accepted, trades, plans,
2640	            intent_idempotency, intent_events)
2641	        if result != records[key]:
2642	            raise ValueError("audit event result does not match its "
2643	                             "record")

2646	    if set(events) != set(records) \

2648	        raise ValueError("settlement sections do not match")

2652	def _settlement_canonical_bytes(
2653	    records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
2654	    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
2655	    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
2656	) -> bytes:
2657	    # Compact UTF-8 JSON, non-ASCII written through, sections in their
2658	    # fixed field order, records/idempotency/audit each keyed by
2659	    # idempotency key in code-point order, terminated by exactly one
2660	    # newline.
2661	    payload = {
2662	        "version": _SETTLE_VERSION,
2663	        "records": {key: records[key] for key in sorted(records)},
2664	        "idempotency": {key: idempotency[key]
2665	                        for key in sorted(idempotency)},
2666	        "audit": {key: events[key] for key in sorted(events)},
2667	    }

2761	def settle(
2762	    jobs: str,
2763	    supply: str,
2764	    signals: str,
2765	    trades: str,
2766	    dispatch: str,
2767	    execution: str,
2768	    advice: str,
2769	    ledger: str,
2770	    settlements: str,
2771	    job_id: str,
2772	    plan_key: str,
2773	    key: str,
2774	    at: int,
2775	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
2776	    """Settle a terminal migration into a durable current binding.
2777	
2778	    The nine paths -- the eight lifecycle paths plus the independent
2779	    settlement ledger -- ``job_id``, ``plan_key`` and ``key`` must be
2780	    non-empty strings resolving to distinct real locations and ``at`` a
2781	    non-boolean non-negative integer settlement moment; any violation
2782	    raises ``ValueError`` before a business file is read.
2783	
2784	    The existing eight layers are read as one snapshot under their
2785	    shared locks together with the settlement ledger's exclusive lock,
2786	    all nine taken in resolved real-path order. None of the eight input
2787	    files is ever rewritten; the settlement lands only in the
2788	    independent ledger. ``plan_key`` must be the idempotency key of the
2789	    ``start`` request that created the job's migration plan.
2790	
2791	    Only a terminal plan settles: an ``active`` plan raises
2792	    ``PermissionError`` and creates no record; a missing job, intent or
2793	    plan raises ``KeyError``. A settlement moment earlier than the
2794	    terminal evidence -- the last step receipt, or the recovery receipt
2795	    for an interrupted plan -- raises ``ValueError``; a legitimate late
2796	    recovery past the job deadline may still settle, so no deadline
2797	    timeout is enforced here. Contradictory terminal evidence, the same
2798	    key carrying a changed request, another key settling the same
2799	    migration, a generation break or contradictory snapshot references
2800	    raise ``ValueError``.
2801	
2802	    A ``migrated`` plan confirms the target version as the job's current
2803	    occupancy and records the source version as the previous-generation
2804	    binding (state ``active``); a ``failed`` or ``interrupted`` plan
2805	    forms a compensation that keeps the current occupancy on the source
2806	    version and releases the target reservation (state
2807	    ``compensated``). The record freezes the continuous running
2808	    generation, the source terminal state, the previous and current
2809	    resource selections, the settlement moment, the state and the audit
2810	    association with every intent-ledger action of the migration.
2811	
2812	    The first request is persisted durably as ``pending`` -- record,
2813	    idempotency binding and audit event in one synced atomic write -- and
2814	    only then advanced to ``active`` or ``compensated`` in a second
2815	    synced atomic write. If the process dies after the pending write,
2816	    re-entering with the same key and request resumes the unfinished
2817	    stage, completes it and still returns the record with ``True``,
2818	    never repeating a committed occupancy, generation or audit action.
2819	    Only an already completed same-key same-request call returns the
2820	    current record with ``False`` and writes no bytes.
2821	
2822	    Missing input files or the settlement ledger parent raise
2823	    ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid arguments or ledger bytes raise
2824	    ``ValueError``; other locking or I/O failures raise ``OSError``.
2825	    """
2826	    for value in (jobs, supply, signals, trades, dispatch, execution,
2827	                  advice, ledger, settlements, job_id, plan_key, key):
2828	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
2829	            raise ValueError("the nine paths, job_id, plan_key and key "
2830	                             "must be non-empty strings")
2831	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
2832	        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")
2833	
2834	    (job_real, supply_real, signal_real, trades_real, dispatch_real,
2835	     execution_real, advice_real, ledger_real, settlement_real) = \
2836	        _resolve_nine_paths(jobs, supply, signals, trades, dispatch,
2837	                            execution, advice, ledger, settlements)
2838	
2839	    store = _get_store(settlement_real)
2840	    with store.lock:
2841	        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
2842	            # The settlement ledger is the only written file and takes
2843	            # the one exclusive lock; every snapshot lock is shared, all
2844	            # nine in the single resolved-real-path order.
2845	            for locked in sorted({job_real, supply_real, signal_real,
2846	                                  trades_real, dispatch_real,
2847	                                  execution_real, advice_real, ledger_real,
2848	                                  settlement_real}):
2849	                stack.enter_context(
2850	                    _lock(locked, shared=(locked != settlement_real)))
2851	
2852	            (accepted, _history, _signal_history, cleared, _decisions,
2853	             _exec_plans, _advice_records, intents, plans,
2854	             intent_idempotency, intent_events) = _load_settle_snapshot(
2855	                job_real, supply_real, signal_real, trades_real,
2856	                dispatch_real, execution_real, advice_real, ledger_real)
2857	            records, idempotency, events, old_bytes = \
2858	                _load_settlement_ledger(
2859	                    settlement_real, accepted, cleared, plans,
2860	                    intent_idempotency, intent_events)
2861	
2862	            request = {"job_id": job_id, "plan_key": plan_key, "at": at}
2863	            existing = idempotency.get(key)
2864	            resume = existing is not None
2865	            if resume:
2866	                if existing != request:
2867	                    raise ValueError("idempotency key was already used "
2868	                                     "with a different request")
2869	                stored = records[key]
2870	                if stored["state"] != "pending":
2871	                    # An already completed same-key same-request call
2872	                    # replays the stored record without writing a byte.
2873	                    return copy.deepcopy(stored), False
2874	
2875	            if not resume:
2876	                if job_id not in accepted:
2877	                    raise KeyError(job_id)
2878	                if job_id not in intents:
2879	                    raise KeyError(job_id)
2880	                plan = plans.get(job_id)
2881	                if plan is None:
2882	                    raise KeyError(job_id)
2883	                start_request = intent_idempotency.get(plan_key)
2884	                if start_request is None \
2885	                        or start_request.get("action") != "start" \
2886	                        or start_request.get("job_id") != job_id:
2887	                    raise KeyError(plan_key)
2888	                if any(record["job_id"] == job_id
2889	                       for record in records.values()):
2890	                    raise ValueError("the terminal migration is already "
2891	                                     "settled under another idempotency "
2892	                                     "key")
2893	                if plan["state"] == "active":
2894	                    raise PermissionError("the migration plan is still "
2895	                                          "active")
2896	                if plan["state"] not in _SETTLE_TERMINAL:
2897	                    raise ValueError("the migration plan is not in a "

2899	                if at < _terminal_plan_at(plan, intent_events):
2900	                    raise ValueError("settlement moment must not precede "
2901	                                     "the terminal plan evidence")
2902	                generation = 1
2903	            else:
2904	                # Resume the durable pending settlement: the plan it
2905	                # bound must still be the same terminal migration, and
2906	                # every frozen field must still follow that snapshot.
2907	                pending = records[key]
2908	                plan = plans.get(job_id)
2909	                if plan is None or job_id not in intents:
2910	                    raise ValueError("a pending settlement lost its "
2911	                                     "migration plan")
2912	                if plan["state"] not in _SETTLE_TERMINAL:
2913	                    raise ValueError("a pending settlement contradicts "
2914	                                     "the migration plan state")
2915	                if at < _terminal_plan_at(plan, intent_events):
2916	                    raise ValueError("settlement moment must not precede "
2917	                                     "the terminal plan evidence")
2918	                generation = pending["generation"]
2919	
2920	            migration = plan["state"]
2921	            final_state = ("active" if migration == "migrated"
2922	                           else "compensated")
2923	            before = copy.deepcopy(plan["source"])
2924	            after = copy.deepcopy(plan["target"]
2925	                                  if migration == "migrated"
2926	                                  else plan["source"])
2927	            audit_keys = _settlement_audit_keys(intent_idempotency, job_id)
2928	            final_record: dict[str, Any] = {
2929	                "job_id": job_id,
2930	                "plan_key": plan_key,
2931	                "generation": generation,
2932	                "migration": migration,
2933	                "before": before,
2934	                "after": after,
2935	                "at": at,
2936	                "state": final_state,
2937	                "audit": audit_keys,
2938	            }
2939	            # Full independent validation against the snapshot before
2940	            # the finalization is accepted on either path.
2941	            _validate_settlement_record(
2942	                final_record, accepted, cleared, plans, intent_idempotency,
2943	                intent_events)
2944	
2945	            if resume:
2946	                for field in ("job_id", "plan_key", "generation",
2947	                              "migration", "before", "after", "at",
2948	                              "audit"):
2949	                    if pending[field] != final_record[field]:
2950	                        raise ValueError("pending settlement contradicts "
2951	                                         "the terminal plan evidence")
2952	                stage_a_bytes = old_bytes
2953	            else:
2954	                pending_record = dict(final_record, state="pending")
2955	                records[key] = pending_record
2956	                idempotency[key] = dict(request)
2957	                events[key] = {"key": key, "request": dict(request),
2958	                               "result": copy.deepcopy(pending_record)}
2959	                stage_a_bytes = _settlement_canonical_bytes(
2960	                    records, idempotency, events)
2961	                # Stage A: the pending settlement, its binding and its
2962	                # audit event durably first.
2963	                _commit_file(settlement_real, stage_a_bytes, old_bytes,
2964	                             prefix=".rebalance-settle-")
2965	
2966	            # Stage B: advance the persisted pending record to its final
2967	            # state. The rollback base is the pending bytes (on a fresh
2968	            # call stage A's bytes, on resume the bytes read from disk),
2969	            # so a crash here leaves a resumable pending settlement
2970	            # rather than a half-finalized one.
2971	            records[key] = final_record
2972	            events[key] = {"key": key, "request": dict(request),
2973	                           "result": copy.deepcopy(final_record)}
2974	            _commit_file(
2975	                settlement_real,
2976	                _settlement_canonical_bytes(records, idempotency, events),
2977	                stage_a_bytes, prefix=".rebalance-settle-final-")

2993	    """Read the job's latest resource binding without writing anything.
2994	
2995	    The nine paths and ``job_id`` must be non-empty strings and the nine
2996	    paths must resolve to distinct real locations; any violation raises
2997	    ``ValueError``. All nine files are read under shared locks in
2998	    resolved real-path order, and no file is created or modified. A job
2999	    whose terminal migration was settled returns the settlement's
3000	    current binding -- the target version for an ``active`` settlement,
3001	    the source version for a ``compensated`` one. A job without a
3002	    completed settlement returns the immutable version its trade froze.
3003	
3004	    An unknown job raises ``KeyError``; an accepted job without a
3005	    recorded trade raises ``LookupError``. Invalid arguments or ledger
3006	    bytes raise ``ValueError``; missing input files raise
3007	    ``FileNotFoundError``; other locking or I/O failures raise
3008	    ``OSError``.
3009	    """
3010	    for value in (jobs, supply, signals, trades, dispatch, execution,
3011	                  advice, ledger, settlements, job_id):

3013	            raise ValueError("the nine paths and job_id must be "
3014	                             "non-empty strings")
3015

3017	     execution_real, advice_real, ledger_real, settlement_real) = \
3018	        _resolve_nine_paths(jobs, supply, signals, trades, dispatch,
3019	                            execution, advice, ledger, settlements)
3020	
3021	    store = _get_store(settlement_real)
3022	    with store.lock:
3023	        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
3024	            # A pure read: every lock, including the settlement
3025	            # ledger's, is shared.
3026	            for locked in sorted({job_real, supply_real, signal_real,
3027	                                  trades_real, dispatch_real,
3028	                                  execution_real, advice_real, ledger_real,
3029	                                  settlement_real}):

3031	
3032	            (accepted, _history, _signal_history, cleared, _decisions,
3033	             _exec_plans, _advice_records, _intents, plans,
3034	             intent_idempotency, intent_events) = _load_settle_snapshot(
3035	                job_real, supply_real, signal_real, trades_real,
